blocks.title: Overwatch Remix: Vol. 1
blocks.body: It’s the sixth anniversary of Overwatch, and we are expanding the annual event into a three-volume series. We’re bringing back fan-favorite skins with a twist, in addition to limited skins you might have missed out on. Play Overwatch Remix: Vol. 1 April 5 – 25 to secure legendary skins, earn weekly rewards, and play all of your favorite seasonal brawls.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Fixed an issue where a turret could be placed through spawn on Watchpoint: Gibraltar Fixed an issue where some audio devices were not populating in-game settings correctly
